sloka: दृष्ट्वा च विमलम् व्योम गत विद्युत् बलाहकम् ।सारस आरव संघुष्टम् विललाप आर्तया गिरा ॥४-३०-५॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā ca vimalam vyoma gata vidyut balāhakam ।sārasa ārava saṁghuṣṭam vilalāpa ārtayā girā ॥4-30-5॥

translations.english: Sitting on top of the mountain shining with gold and minerals, Rama gazed at the pleasant autumnal sky and started thinking of his beloved.
